title: Inject per-session Engram MCP into local agent runtimes
outcome: When a local session's project has Engram enabled, compose an ngram mcp stdio server alongside termal-delegation for Codex, Claude, and ACP runtimes. Bind actor-id to termal:<agent>, session-id to the TermAl session id, and pass the project work-authority grant without exposing it in API/state snapshots. Preserve the existing TermAl-only config when Engram is disabled or unavailable.
acceptance: Codex, Claude, and ACP spawn/resume configs include exactly one per-session Engram MCP server only for enabled local Engram projects; actor/session/project-file/home/grant arguments are exact; the grant stays redacted; projectless, remote, and disabled sessions remain byte-stable; focused runtime config tests pass.
